args.description: a slow wide horizontal sweep of the golden halberd in front of him, the blade staying inside the picture, then back into the stance. The halberd is plain gold metal that never glows or sparkles; nothing appears around him. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy white hair and blue eyes, a long white coat with grey tails, a black shirt, black trousers and grey boots, holding a golden halberd
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a golden halberd
